claim: Patchline normalizes migrations written for different ORMs — Django, Rails, SQLAlchemy, and Prisma — into a single canonical intermediate representation so that downstream analyses run once against one schema-change vocabulary instead of four dialect-specific parsers. The worker maps each dialect's operation verbs and type names onto a canonical {op, table, column, type, nullable} tuple, and verifies that operations expressing the same intent in different dialects normalize to byte-identical canonical tuples. The gate proves the four dialects converge on one canonical form for an equivalent add-not-null-column operation and that an unrecognized dialect is rejected rather than silently mis-normalized.
